lines.1: The word 'small' seemed to be the final straw.
lines.3: 「Hah! Nobody asked for your lectures! You think you can stand there and yap just because I've kept quiet? I don't want to hear some old hag nagging me!」
lines.4: Crab glared at her with all her might.
lines.5: 「I am saying this for your own good.」
lines.7: 「And since nobody else is going to say it, I will! What's with that sword?」
lines.8: 「It is a famous blade. Hell Butterfly, the symbol of public order bestowed by the headmaster upon each successive disciplinary chair.」
lines.9: 「...More importantly, you use remarkably disrespectful language toward your elders.」
lines.10: Her face asked what kind of upbringing Kinu had received.
lines.11: 「Oh, that was real fancy talk. So what, asshole? Gonna do what all good little teacher's pets do and tattle on me?」
lines.13: 「I hate getting lectured! It feels like I lost or something!」
lines.15: 「And calling me small? Insulting people over their bodies? Who do you think you are? Are you really that great? That strong? That important?!」
lines.16: 「...It seems you have not learned your lesson.」
lines.17: 「A somewhat harsher punishment appears necessary. When I act, I see things through.」
lines.18: 「The disciplinary committee may not look it, but we are an athletic organization.」
lines.19: She already had the eyes of a samurai, if you asked me.
lines.20: 「I'd like to see you try. You're old enough to know the difference between what you can and can't do, aren't you?」
lines.21: 「Subaru! You're up! Fight for real this time! I'll buy you the sesame seeds off a bean bun, so teach this stuck-up woman how harsh the world can be!」
lines.24: 「Nobody's doing that for a few sesame seeds.」
lines.26: She was like a starving animal...
lines.27: 「You are the one who must learn how harsh the world can be. Relying on others is a poor quality.」
lines.28: 「A-are you gonna hit me?! If you do, I'll run straight to the faculty office and tell them!」
lines.29: 「I would never use my fists against another woman. Nor would I kick or headbutt her.」
lines.30: 「Above all, the rules forbid causing injury while administering punishment. I obey the rules.」
lines.32: 「...No good. My body's still numb. I can't move.」
lines.34: 「A fine bunch of useless garbage you are!」
lines.35: 「No, I just don't want to help you.」
lines.37: 「H-hmph! I won't go down without a fight!」
lines.38: Crab clapped her hands sharply right in front of the disciplinary chair's face.
lines.40: Then she tried to make a run for it.
lines.41: But the disciplinary chair did not so much as blink.
lines.42: She seized Crab firmly by the scruff of her neck.
lines.43: Then she casually lifted her into the air with one hand.
lines.46: 「Relax. Struggling will only make it hurt more.」
lines.47: She pulled Crab in toward herself and put her in a...
lines.49: 「Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow! It hurts, it hurts, it hurts!」
lines.50: A series of ugly creaks came from her body.
lines.58: 「The next one will hurt more. Apologize, and I will release you.」
lines.64: She was crying her eyes out.
lines.65: I was starting to feel sorry for her.
lines.69: In a way, she was kind of cool.
lines.70: 「This is a problem. Any farther and I truly will break a bone.」
lines.71: She released Crab, who dropped to the ground.
lines.73: 「Damn right... If nothing else, I'll see my stubbornness through to the end!」
lines.76: 「Your language is unacceptable and your logic is a shambles, but your courage to state your position firmly to an elder is also commendable.」
lines.77: 「It is only a shame that you put those qualities to such poor use.」
